title: Beautiful but very fragile.
text:
Beautiful but very fragile.. What a beautiful bedspread this is. The colors are vibrant, and the squares are all different pattern and size. I didn't expect it's high quality for the price. I'm thinking about getting a bunch more for gifts.
I have to change my review because the outer threads break easily and look terrible. I am cutting the broken threads as they occur because removing all threads would be extremely time consuming. I’m also worried that the patches and backing will come apart if the threads are removed. I have snagged them with my toenails, and while making the bed.
UPDATE: the kantha stitching breaks very easily. I cannot use it for sleeping. I've had to clip the broken stitches, but I can't keep up with it so the broken stitches look like spaghetti. I would not buy it again.
